bugs.what: Barrow shade combat was grindy: 3 turns to kill a 4-HP enemy with poor die rolls (1, 3, 6 on d20). Each miss cost 1 HP.

suggestions: Combat: Lower barrow shade HP or give it lower AC so the fight resolves in 1-2 hits, or make fleeing/bypassing combat clearer as an option.
The Scholar class felt perfectly tuned for the verses path—consider highlighting this synergy earlier if players aren't discovering it naturally.
